scene: The tin keeper robot points an oily finger toward jammed brass machinery.
picture: Side view on a level cobblestone floor. On the far left, a red lever protrudes from a brass engine. Centre-left, the player with sketchbook stands near the tin keeper robot pointing right. In the centre, large exposed brass gears jam on a fallen key. Far right, an open arched service doorway vents steam.
shown: A red emergency lever sticking out on the far left machinery casing
A cluster of whirring gears jammed by a key in the centre
An open arched service doorway on the far right releasing hissing steam
